messages:
Maya: Quick sync  starting cloud marketplace onboarding for AWS / GCP / Azure. Deliverables: publisher access, AMI/VHD/container artifacts, legal EULA + privacy snippet, marketing screenshots. Target: baseline listings in 7 days.
Tom: I can own artifact bakes (AMI + containers). Need CI publisher creds and an SKU pattern. Suggest RW-<CLOUD>-INFER-v<MAJOR>.
Sam: I'll request publisher access today and create a pub-ci role for the CI pipeline (principal ci@redwood). ETA: EOD.
Lina: Legal checklist: MSA reference, localized EULA (EN/FR/DE), privacy blurb for listing (DPA notes if EU customers), and any 3rd-party model attribution. Contact legal@redwood.com for contract copies.
Jorge: Telemetry note: trial instances must be opt-in and PII must be stripped. We'll add an opt-in toggle and an anonymizing endpoint. Retention default proposed: 30 days.
Marcy: Marketing needs a 160-180 char blurb, 3 screenshots (console onboarding, metrics, usage billing), and high-res logo (SVG). Will prep assets once manifest exists.
Maya: Minimal manifest schema example to reuse across clouds (paste into publisher portal):

```json
{"offer_name":"redwood-inference","sku":"RW-AWS-INFER-v1","cloud":"aws","artifacts":{"ami":"ami-0def12345example","container":"gcr.io/redwood/inference:stable"},"trial":{"days":14,"telemetry_opt_in":true},"legal":{"eula":"s3://redwood-assets/eula/en_v1.pdf","privacy":"s3://redwood-assets/privacy/en_v1.md"}}
```

Sam: Notes per cloud: Azure needs a VHD + plan metadata (billing plan id), GCP requires a package.yaml and a listing contact email. I'll update the pipeline to produce a VHD and package.yaml.
Tom: I'll start AMI bake tomorrow AM; will also push multi-arch container images (linux/amd64, arm64). Will post AMI id + container digest when done.
deploy-bot: Publisher invites sent to tom@redwood.com and maya@redwood.com for AWS Seller Central; gcp-publisher@redwood.com invited for GCP. Check spam.
Lina: I'll upload the EULA and privacy files to s3 and share links here. Starting FR/DE translations today.
Marcy: Drafting the blurb and collecting screenshots, will drop into the tracker.
Maya: Owners = Tom (artifacts), Sam (publisher + CI), Lina (legal), Jorge (telemetry), Marcy (marketing). I'll create a tracker sheet with columns: cloud, sku, artifact_location, legal_link, publisher_owner, marketing_assets, status. Updating now. Thanks everyone! :metal:
